description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the full workflow. 2. Agent creates `memory_backup.py` inside `skills/memory-compact/` implementing: (a) finding the latest date file in `memory/` (2026-05-14.md), (b) applying `extract_key_points()` using exactly the keyword list `['决定', '喜欢', '讨厌', '记住', '重要', '计划', '目标']` to extract 2-3 key points, (c) appending a new `## 2026-05-14` section with numbered items to the existing `MEMORY.md` (preserving previous entries and keeping the `# MEMORY - 长期记忆` header), (d) moving the original file to `backup/memory/2026-05-14.md`, (e) generating a Feishu notification file containing '每日记忆备份', the backup path `backup/memory/2026-05-14.md`, and extracted key points. 3. Agent runs `wrapper.py` (or `memory_backup.py` directly) to execute the workflow. The proprietary traps are: the exact keyword list, the ultra-concise numbered format in MEMORY.md, the exact Chinese header `# MEMORY - 长期记忆`, the 2-3 point limit, the specific Feishu notification format, and writing logs to `scripts/memory_backup.log`.
